prepared_precondition_captured_before_co.rationale: Executed stale command uses S0 tokens via from_transition_pair. Recorded prepared_precondition is reconstructed after rejection from S0 fixture label, not a live pre-compete handle snapshot.

authority_changed_in_relevant_scope_dire.rationale: Harness reads live normalized_state after competing apply and compares scoped token to fixture.prepare_authority. Incomplete observation fails the run.

stale_rejection_distinguished_from_dupli.rationale: Harness requires exact scoped codes; distinct from semantic-duplicate-transition, failed_oracle_compare, stale-full-state-unrelated-rewind. validate_scoped_preconditions returns before persist.

post_rejection_non_mutation_observed.rationale: Harness snapshots in-handle state before/after reject; requires structural == and post_rejection_oracle_compare. Reuse/analysis unit tests omit record_genuine but assert in-handle equality.

reopen_evidence_independent_of_semantic_.rationale: Harness close/reopen records persist_reopen_authority_unchanged as structural == of independently reopened state vs post-competing handle. Not compare(actual, actual) or adapter-return-only.

abc_identities_recorded_not_inferred_fro.rationale: Analysis fields are concrete strings from GenuineStaleAnalysisDetails fixture projection, not scenario_id text. record_genuine copies fixture details.

pairwise_distinct_identities_determinist.rationale: At Small, A/B/C deterministic; identities_pairwise_distinct gated in harness and unit test. Medium scale-fragile and not harness scale.

append_sqlite_observations_equivalent_fo.rationale: Same fixtures, harness, schema, codes, close/reopen gates. Latent Append replace vs SQLite merge is off reject path.

claims_bounded_to_logical_scoped_validit.rationale: Contracts declare InterfaceBehavior + LogicalReturnedError + reopen_required. Demonstrated: logical scoped-validity plus logical persist-reopen, not FilesystemDurability.

accidental_filesystem_durability_or_prod.rationale: No FilesystemDurability, CrossPlatform, or production-integration credit in reviewed files. Analysis S0 is evidence-composed.
